source: Owner answers pasted from the Hub's Questions tab (verbatim): grilling round 4.
raw:
settle_on_arrival: The seller sets the Goods aside for that Trader when it leaves home, so they are always there on arrival (nobody else can buy them meanwhile)
seller_choice_rule: That rule
tax_target: Break even at about 1.25× base price (today's Peasant numbers): profit when buying cheap, loss above 1.25×  | note: Also make resident pay standard tax. They only pay tax if base resources are provided(both wood + potato in peasant case, otherwise peasants leave like they do now right?) Same for luxury, each luxury gives 25% bonus gold for each peasant so 6 gold base + 3 for 1 luxury and 3 for another. That's an example, balance it so it makes sense.
bridge: A road piece built on a water hex beside land, so Traders and Porters can cross narrow water; costs several times a road (proposal: 5×), Traders cross at road speed  | note: Up to 3x tiles over water(5 tiles total since 2 of them connect on a land tile, but they can be placed on top of a building on land, but not fisherman on water
shortcuts_final: Change some (say in the note)  | note: F1-F2-F3 for game speed. T for castle, remove M. Right click to cancel currenet action/tool in hand.

settle_on_arrival.outcome: Seller sets the Goods aside when the Trader leaves; the Trader pays on arrival (30% of it to the Crown).

seller_choice_rule.outcome: Cost per unit = price + trip time x value of time (higher when starving, rich or short of free Traders); split big needs across sellers when Traders are free.

tax_target.note: Standard Tax per resident, paid only while all Basic Needs are provided (Peasants: Wood and Potato); each Luxury provided adds a bonus (example: +25% of the base Tax per Luxury). Numbers to balance.
tax_target.outcome: Tune to break even at ~1.25x base. Tax rule details in round 5.

bridge.note: Up to 3 water hexes (5 hexes with its two land ends). Land ends may be hexes with buildings; never over a Fishery's water hex.
bridge.outcome: Bridge: up to 3 water hexes between two land hexes, ~5x road cost, road speed; not over a Fishery.

shortcuts_final.note: F1/F2/F3 game speed; T opens the Castle; no mute key; right-click cancels the current tool.
shortcuts_final.outcome: Keys: 1-6 build tabs, 1-8 buildings, Space pause, F1/F2/F3 speed, R research, T Castle, Esc close, Shift keeps tool, right-click cancels (pan conflict asked in round 5).
